definitions.explanation: A person who installs, maintains, and repairs electrical systems and equipment.

examples.japanese: {電気技師|でんきぎし}に{配線|はいせん}を{点検|てんけん}してもらった。
examples.english: I had an electrician inspect the wiring.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{電気技師|でんきぎし}の{資格|しかく}を{持|も}っている。
{停電|ていでん}の{原因|げんいん}を{電気技師|でんきぎし}が{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: An electrician is investigating the cause of the power outage.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
・{電気工事士|でんきこうじし} (licensed electrician - official term for the Japanese qualification)
・{電気屋|でんきや}さん (electrician - colloquial)

QUALIFICATION NOTE: In Japan, {電気工事士|でんきこうじし} is the official qualification for electrical work. There are two levels: {第一種|だいいっしゅ} (Class 1) and {第二種|だいにしゅ} (Class 2).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{電気技師|でんきぎし}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call an electrician)
・{電気技師|でんきぎし}に{修理|しゅうり}を{頼|たの}む (to ask an electrician for repairs)
